text.content: A You and your partner have a picture of the same accident. Tell your partner what
the witnesses said in your picture. Your partner will report what other witnesses said. Find four
She had a large pizza in one hand.
The driver didn’t stop at the light.
The driver wasn't on his cell phone
A: Peter told the police officer that the driver hadn't stopped at the light.
B: Jan also said he hadn't stopped at the light. She said that she'd seen the light turn yellow.
A: But Peter told the police officer he'd seen the light turn red. So that's different.
